date_note: Date is the guilty plea, Monday 16 November (CPS press release of that day; The Record and heise, 17 November). The sentence was reported on 23 November by Haberler.com, citing the BBC, the day the CPS had set for sentencing at Woolwich Crown Court.
exec: A UK prosecution of a Lapsus$ member over the Rockstar, BT/EE, Revolut and Uber hacks ended in a seven-year sentence, per Haberler.com citing the BBC.
plain: A Lapsus$ hacker who leaked Grand Theft Auto VI videos was sentenced to seven years in prison and released the same day, Haberler.com reports citing the BBC.
summary: Arion Kurtaj, a Lapsus$ member, was sentenced to seven years in prison and conditionally released the same day because time spent in hospital and prison was deemed sufficient, Haberler.com reports citing the BBC. The CPS says he pleaded guilty to hacks on Rockstar Games, taking 90 Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay videos, and on BT/EE, Revolut and Uber, with sentencing at Woolwich Crown Court on 23 November.
title: Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj sentenced to seven years over GTA 6 leak hack and released the same day, report says
